sections.heading: Execution checklist (you hold keys)

sections.heading: Risks & stop rules
sections.body:

• Re-open earlier if: Mark exits new band within 6h (vol expansion)
• Custody: Genesis / agent never hold your LP NFT or private keys

sections.heading: Monitoring plan

2. Alert if fee APR (rolling) drops > 40% vs post-rebalance day-1
